The spay surgery itself went reasonably well, but unfortunately, we were very disappointed with the aftercare.

Following the vet’s advice, we purchased a recovery jacket from the clinic to protect our kitten’s wound. However, the wrong size was recommended and the jacket was far too tight. During the follow-up check, this was also not noticed.

We later discovered that the wound had become badly damaged and had started to deteriorate, apparently due to the jacket being too tight and rubbing against the area. The jacket was meant to protect the wound, but in our experience, it ended up causing further problems.

As a result, we had to take our kitten to another vet again to have the wound checked and treated, causing her unnecessary discomfort and us additional time, stress and medical expenses.

I understand that complications can happen after surgery, but when a recovery jacket is recommended and supplied by the clinic, I would expect the correct size to be selected and the wound and jacket to be checked carefully during the follow-up appointment.

The surgery itself was fine, but the aftercare was extremely disappointing. I hope the clinic takes this feedback seriously and reviews how recovery jackets and post-operative checks are handled in the future.

> I cannot thank the entire team at The Vet Centre Glasgow enough for the exceptional care they provided to my dog. From the very beginning, every member of the team showed genuine compassion, professionalism, and attention to every detail.

What truly sets this clinic apart is not only the outstanding medical care, but also the humanity with which they treat both their patients and their owners. Throughout a very difficult time, I always felt supported and listened to.

The veterinarians were incredibly dedicated, making themselves available even outside normal working hours whenever I needed advice or assistance. Their commitment and willingness to help, even with seemingly small but important aspects such as ensuring prescriptions were available without delay, made an enormous difference.

It is rare to find a team that combines such high clinical standards with genuine kindness and empathy. I wholeheartedly recommend The Vet Centre Glasgow to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care. Thank you for everything you have done for my dog and for the support you gave me throughout the entire process.
Paola owner of Lolo

My dog Luckie has been with this vet since he was 8 weeks old, and now he’s almost one. From his first vaccines to his neutering and now dealing with a long stretch of acid reflux, this practice has been there for us through every important stage.

Whenever I was worried about Luckie’s condition, the receptionists always tried their best to get us the earliest appointment. The vets and nurses are all super kind, always smiling and taking time to explain everything clearly. This is my first dog, and honestly, I’m the kind of owner who worries a lot. During this whole reflux issue, I probably showed up or called way too many times, but every single vet I met was so patient and caring. You can even hear the smiles in their voices over the phone. The nurses are wonderful too, real people with warmth and personality (like the one who loves Sanrio!). Everyone here has been so gentle and kind to Luckie. He never shows fear going to the vet, which says a lot.

I’m really grateful for this practice and everyone who works here. Highly recommend ❤️
